rawContent: Raising oil and fuel prices, regardless of supply or demand, is a perfect way to get people to agree to more localized pipelines, increased local fuel production instead of investing in renewable energy, and shirk any responsibility to the #ClimateCrisis.

Taking #ClimateCrisis and our ability to survive on the planet aside, how much oil do people think we're going to be able to suck out of the planet before the wells run dry?

They say about 50 years.

I'll be long gone, but that world is going to suck real bad.
